[2026-09-15] Me: You can’t use your old content on new accounts unless you properly repurpose

[2026-09-15] Me: Content is unique to each account so if you post it on another account it will know it’s the same videos. Repurposing changes pixels, audio, metadata etc. so that you can use same video without ig detecting it
